## About
Advanced Automotive Service Center is a family owned auto repair and tire shop on Park Blvd in Seminole. We take care of the cars that get you to the grocery store, school, the office and family gatherings, and we work on most makes and models.
We want every visit to be a positive one. One customer who came in with a broken A/C wrote that Chris, John and Xavier took their time to show and explain what was going on, without trying to oversell. Another has been coming to us for years and calls us the only place she trusts.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 423 Google reviews. Give us a call or schedule your service online.

## Services
- AC Repair: When the A/C quits, we diagnose it and walk you through your options.
- Cooling System Repair: Repairs to keep your engine running at the right temperature.
- Brake Repair: Brake repair for the car you drive every day.
- Engine Diagnostics and Performance: We find out what is going on with your engine and explain it before any work starts.
- Electrical and Electronic Systems: Diagnosis and repair of your vehicle's electrical and electronic systems.
- Steering and Suspension System: Steering and suspension work for a steady, comfortable ride.
- Wheel Alignment: Alignment to help your car track straight.
- Tire Services: Car, truck and SUV tires from trusted names, plus off-road and commercial tires.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you offer purchase options?
A: Yes. We offer convenient purchase options through Synchrony so you can get the repairs you need when you need them.

Q: Do you honor extended warranties?
A: Most extended warranties are honored here. Give us a call and we'll check yours.

Q: Do you work on fleet vehicles?
A: Yes. We service light-duty and medium duty trucks and vans. If you're part of a fleet account, talk with us to see what we can do for you.
